info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Employee Certification Management API
info.description: The Employee Certification Management API facilitates the updating of employee certification records within the human resource management system. This endpoint allows authorized users to patch specific certification details for employees, ensuring accurate and up-to-date information. Typical consumers include HR personnel and managers seeking to maintain compliance and track employee qualifications. The API streamlines operations related to workforce development and regulatory adherence.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the certification details of a specific employee identified by their unique employee ID. Utilize this endpoint to modify information related to certifications, ensuring that employee records remain accurate and up to date.

requestBody.description: Update the employee certification details for the specified employee ID (EMP-900045). This request body should contain the necessary fields to modify the existing certification information, such as certification type, issue date, and expiration date.
